title: Great way to spend some time in Barcelona.

title: A Must See Show
text: As an empath this experience wrecked me it was so beautifully emotional and engaging.  The art of flamenco on it’s best display.  Incredibly gifted musicians and dancers with very kind and friendly hosts.

title: Real intimate
text: There was only 10-15 people and the show was amazing so it felt like a private show to us and the drinks were good priced and the people were friendly so I recommend this place if you looking for something “local” feeling and intimate
author: Ali_G

title: Incredible show!!
text: What an incredible show!! The performers were all so talented and we were so amazed by all of them. We would see this show again and again!!
author: VictoriaLynn_T

title: Musical immersion of Flamenco culture
text:
Beginner lovers of Flamenco culture in Italy, the first thing my wife and I wanted to do as soon as we landed in Barcelona is to book this experience in the homeland of Flamenco.
We were immersed in this fantastic world... The quartet that gave us this experience were nothing short of extraordinary, magical 💕
The place is beautiful and the sangria is exquisite.
Experience that we recommend💯🤠🌈
author: Jet04669989319
